description: List a directory inside the roots as a name tree, walking up to maxDepth levels. Use when you need to see what a folder holds. Do not use it to find files by name or glob; use `find_files` instead, `read` or `search_text` for contents, `stat` for one path. Skips hidden entries, .gitignore matches, and build and tool folders unless includeHidden or includeIgnored is set, naming the ignore-rule folders it hid. At most 20,000 entries are kept. A timeout returns a partial result with stoppedReason. Errors: NOT_DIRECTORY for a file, ACCESS_DENIED outside the roots. Returns tree text, entries[{name, relativePath, type, size?}], totals, unexpandedDirectories, and skippedInaccessible. A cut result adds nextCursor (about 5 min) and resourceUri (about 60 s).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor. Pass it unchanged for the next page. Pages come from one snapshot taken on the first call. It lasts 5 min past its last page; on refusal, retry without it.

exclude.description: Globs for entries to leave out, with everything under a matching folder. Without / a pattern matches a name at any depth (vendor, *.test.ts); with / it matches the path relative to path.

items.description: Relative glob pattern under the search root (e.g. "**/*.ts", "src/**/*.js").

includeIgnored.description: Include .gitignore matches and build and tool folders (node_modules, .git, dist, build, out, tmp, coverage)

includeSizes.description: Show file sizes and a totals line in the tree (stats every file, slower on big trees)

maxDepth.description: Levels to walk; 1 = direct children. Directories at the limit are shown, not expanded.

maxEntries.description: Entries per page; changing it keeps a cursor valid

path.description: Directory to list (default: the only root; required with several roots)

sortBy.description: Order within each directory, after directories (size: largest file first; sizes appear only with includeSizes)

name: list
title: List
